newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close up on buying pressure.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close up on buying pressure.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed up on buying pressure as blue chips in engineering sector continued to attract retail investors, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index closed 21.73 points or 0.61 percent up at 1,905.59 on a turnover of 74.8 million taka on Monday. Of 97 traded issues 51 rose and 44 lost.

"The market is recovering from a lingering bearishness on fresh commitments," said a broker. Singer Bangladesh gained 244 taka to 12,681, Amam Sea Food Industries rose 17 to 4,017 and Beximco Pharmaceuticals shed 1 to 188.
